tool:comment_add.text0: Add a comment as Acrobat's commenting tools do. Geometry is in points with the origin at the top-left of the displayed page, y down (as in page_render images at 72 dpi and text_find rects). note: `at` [x, y] (icon top-left). stamp: `at` [x, y] (its centre) and `stamp`: approved, completed, confidential, draft, final, for comment, for public release, information only, not approved, not for public release, preliminary results, void, accepted, initial here, rejected, sign here, witness; dynamic: true for the dynamic approved/confidential/received/reviewed/revised stamps with a By … at … line. highlight/underline/strikeout/squiggly: `find` (text on the page to mark; every match with all: true) or `quads`. rectangle/oval/textbox: `rect` [x0, y0, x1, y1]. line/arrow: `from`, `to`. ink: `strokes` [[[x, y], …], …]. polygon/cloud/polyline (connected lines): `points` [[x, y], …]. callout: `rect` (its text box), `to` (the point the arrow touches), optional `knee`. caret (inserted text): `at`, the insertion point on the baseline. replace (Replace Text): `find` or `quads` like highlight, `contents` the replacement. attachment: `path` (the file), `at`, optional `icon` (PushPin, Paperclip, Graph, Tag). Undoable.
tool:comment_add.desc: Add a comment as Acrobat's commenting tools do. Geometry is in points with the origin at the top-left of the displayed page, y down (as in page_render images at 72 dpi and text_find rects). note: `at` [x, y] (icon top-left). stamp: `at` [x, y] (its centre) and `stamp`: approved, completed, confidential, draft, final, for comment, for public release, information only, not approved, not for public release, preliminary results, void, accepted, initial here, rejected, sign here, witness; dynamic: true for the dynamic approved/confidential/received/reviewed/revised stamps with a By … at … line. highlight/underline/strikeout/squiggly: `find` (text on the page to mark; every match with all: true) or `quads`. rectangle/oval/textbox: `rect` [x0, y0, x1, y1]. line/arrow: `from`, `to`. ink: `strokes` [[[x, y], …], …]. polygon/cloud/polyline (connected lines): `points` [[x, y], …]. callout: `rect` (its text box), `to` (the point the arrow touches), optional `knee`. caret (inserted text): `at`, the insertion point on the baseline. replace (Replace Text): `find` or `quads` like highlight, `contents` the replacement. attachment: `path` (the file), `at`, optional `icon` (PushPin, Paperclip, Graph, Tag). Undoable.

tool:doc_close.desc: Close a document. Fails if it has unsaved changes unless discard_changes is true.

tool:doc_combine.desc: Combine PDFs, in order, into one (bookmarks are kept under one entry per file). pages optionally chooses each file's pages, in step with paths: a range such as "1-3, 6" or null for all pages.

tool:doc_compare.desc: Compare the text of two open documents: other is the older version, doc the newer. Returns counts and each change (replaced, inserted, deleted) with the old and new text, pages (1-based) and rectangles (points, origin bottom-left).

tool:doc_compare_mark.desc: Add the differences from other (older) to doc (newer) as comments in doc: highlights over replaced (blue) and inserted (green) text, notes where text was deleted (red), authored Compare. Undoable.

tool:doc_compare_report.text0: Write the compare summary report (a PDF listing every change) to path.
tool:doc_compare_report.desc: Write the compare summary report (a PDF listing every change) to path.

tool:doc_create.params: {from*:string, height?:number, name?:string, pages?:integer, path?:string, paths?:array, text?:string, width?:number}
tool:doc_create.text0: Create a new, unsaved document and return it like doc_open: `blank` (pages, width, height in points; default 1 US Letter page), `images` (paths of PNG, JPEG, TIFF (every page), GIF or BMP files, one page each at the image's resolution) or `text` (a .txt path, or `text` directly). tool:doc_create.desc: Create a new, unsaved document and return it like doc_open: `blank` (pages, width, height in points; default 1 US Letter page), `images` (paths of PNG, JPEG, TIFF (every page), GIF or BMP files, one page each at the image's resolution) or `text` (a .txt path, or `text` directly). tool:doc_export_all_images.text0: Write the images that pages use into a folder (`<name>_Page_<n>_Image_<k>.jpg|png`), each once: JPEG images unchanged, others as PNG with their soft mask as alpha. min_size skips images with fewer pixels on their shorter side. tool:doc_export_all_images.desc: Write the images that pages use into a folder (`<name>_Page_<n>_Image_<k>.jpg|png`), each once: JPEG images unchanged, others as PNG with their soft mask as alpha. min_size skips images with fewer pixels on their shorter side. Images that can't be decoded yet (JPEG 2000, JBIG2, CCITT, separations) are listed under skipped. Includes unsaved edits.

tool:doc_export_data.text0: Write comments and/or form data to path; the extension picks the format: .xfdf or .fdf (comments and/or fields), .xml, .csv or .txt (form data). what: all (default), comments, fields.
tool:doc_export_data.desc: Write comments and/or form data to path; the extension picks the format: .xfdf or .fdf (comments and/or fields), .xml, .csv or .txt (form data). what: all (default), comments, fields.

tool:doc_export_images.text0: Write pages as PNG, JPEG or TIFF files (`<name>_page_<n>.png|jpg|tif`) into a folder, at a resolution (default 150 dpi). JPEG and TIFF are flattened onto white paper. Includes unsaved edits.
tool:doc_export_images.desc: Write pages as PNG, JPEG or TIFF files (`<name>_page_<n>.png|jpg|tif`) into a folder, at a resolution (default 150 dpi). JPEG and TIFF are flattened onto white paper. Includes unsaved edits.

tool:doc_export_office.text0: Export a PDF ▸ Word (.docx), HTML (.html, one file with images inline) or RTF (.rtf), chosen by path's extension: paragraphs in reading order, headings from larger text, bold and italic, images where they fall, a page break between pages.
tool:doc_export_office.desc: Export a PDF ▸ Word (.docx), HTML (.html, one file with images inline) or RTF (.rtf), chosen by path's extension: paragraphs in reading order, headings from larger text, bold and italic, images where they fall, a page break between pages.

tool:doc_export_text.text0: Write the reading-order text of pages to a .txt file (pages separated by form feeds).
tool:doc_export_text.desc: Write the reading-order text of pages to a .txt file (pages separated by form feeds).

tool:doc_flatten.text0: Merge comment and/or form field appearances into the page content, so they print and display everywhere but can no longer be edited. Undoable until saved.
tool:doc_flatten.desc: Merge comment and/or form field appearances into the page content, so they print and display everywhere but can no longer be edited. Undoable until saved.

tool:doc_header_footer.text0: Add a header and/or footer to pages. Text boxes: header_left/center/right, footer_left/center/right. tool:doc_header_footer.desc: Add a header and/or footer to pages. Text boxes: header_left/center/right, footer_left/center/right. tool:doc_hidden_info.desc: What Remove Hidden Information would remove, by category (metadata, attachments, comments, form-fields, hidden-text, hidden-layers, bookmarks, links-actions-scripts, private-data) with counts.

tool:doc_import_data.text0: Import comments and/or field values from an XFDF, FDF, XML, CSV or tab-delimited text file (detected from its content). Comments with the same name are replaced; values go through the form's formats and validation. Undoable.
tool:doc_import_data.desc: Import comments and/or field values from an XFDF, FDF, XML, CSV or tab-delimited text file (detected from its content). Comments with the same name are replaced; values go through the form's formats and validation. Undoable.

tool:doc_info.text0: Metadata, page sizes and labels, bookmarks, annotations, form fields, links, layers, attachments, fonts, security and repair notes.
tool:doc_info.desc: Metadata, page sizes and labels, bookmarks, annotations, form fields, links, layers, attachments, fonts, security and repair notes.

tool:doc_initial_view.params: {binding?:string, center_window?:boolean, display_title?:boolean, doc*:integer, fit_window?:boolean, full_screen?:boolean, hide_menubar?:boolean, hide_toolbar?:boolean, hide_window_ui?:boolean, language?:string, layout?:string, magnification?, navigation?:string, page?:integer}
tool:doc_initial_view.text0: Read or change how the document opens (Document Properties ▸ Initial View) and its reading options: navigation (page, bookmarks, pages, attachments, layers), layout (default, single, continuous, two_up, two_up_continuous, two_up_cover, two_up_continuous_cover), magnification (default, actual, fit_page, fit_width, fit_height, fit_visible, or a percentage), page, window options (fit_window, center_window, full_screen, display_title), interface options (hide_menubar, hide_toolbar, hide_window_ui), language and binding (left, right). tool:doc_list.text0: List the open documents with their ids, page counts and unsaved state.
tool:doc_list.desc: List the open documents with their ids, page counts and unsaved state.

tool:doc_open.text0: Open a PDF file and return its document id, page count and whether it can be edited.
tool:doc_open.desc: Open a PDF file and return its document id, page count and whether it can be edited.

tool:doc_open_revision.text0: Open saved revision `revision` (1 = the oldest) of a document as a new, unsaved document, to see the file as it was then.
tool:doc_open_revision.desc: Open saved revision `revision` (1 = the oldest) of a document as a new, unsaved document, to see the file as it was then.

tool:doc_optimize.params: {color?:object, discard?:array, discard_alternate_images?:boolean, discard_print_settings?:boolean, discard_tags?:boolean, discard_thumbnails?:boolean, doc*:integer, flate_unencoded?:boolean, gray?:object, path*:string, remove_invalid_links?:boolean, remove_unreferenced_dests?:boolean}
tool:doc_optimize.text0: Write an optimized copy to `path` (Acrobat's PDF Optimizer). color / gray: { downsample, ppi, above_ppi, compression: jpeg|zip|retain, quality 1–100 } (defaults: downsample to 150 ppi above 225, JPEG 60). Images are measured where pages draw them and replaced only when smaller. discard_*: thumbnails (default true), alternate_images (true), tags, print_settings; flate_unencoded (true); remove_invalid_links and remove_unreferenced_dests (true). discard: Remove Hidden Information categories (metadata, attachments, comments, form-fields, hidden-text, hidden-layers, bookmarks, links-actions-scripts, private-data). tool:doc_protect.params: {accessibility?:boolean, changes?:string, compatibility?:string, copy?:boolean, doc*:integer, encrypt_metadata?:boolean, open_password?:string, permissions_password?:string, printing?:string}
tool:doc_protect.text0: Encrypt the document (applied by the next doc_save, a full rewrite). open_password is needed to open it; permissions_password is needed to change security and lifts the restrictions given by printing/changes/copy. Passwords are never echoed back. Undoable.
tool:doc_protect.desc: Encrypt the document (applied by the next doc_save, a full rewrite). open_password is needed to open it; permissions_password is needed to change security and lifts the restrictions given by printing/changes/copy. Passwords are never echoed back. Undoable.

tool:doc_remove_hidden.desc: Remove the listed categories (see doc_hidden_info), or every category when none are listed (Sanitize Document). Form fields are flattened so their values stay visible. The next save rewrites the whole file. Undoable until saved.

tool:doc_remove_marks.text0: Remove every header and footer, watermark or background PrintCraft (or a compatible tool) added. Undoable.
tool:doc_remove_marks.desc: Remove every header and footer, watermark or background PrintCraft (or a compatible tool) added. Undoable.

tool:doc_revisions.text0: List the document's saved revisions (oldest first): each incremental update is one. Returns revision number, where it ends in the file and its size, and which signatures sign exactly that revision.
tool:doc_revisions.desc: List the document's saved revisions (oldest first): each incremental update is one. Returns revision number, where it ends in the file and its size, and which signatures sign exactly that revision.

tool:doc_save.text0: Save to its own file (an incremental update, which keeps signatures valid) or to a new path (a full rewrite). The write is atomic.
tool:doc_save.desc: Save to its own file (an incremental update, which keeps signatures valid) or to a new path (a full rewrite). The write is atomic.

tool:doc_set_info.text0: Set a document information entry such as Title, Author, Subject or Keywords. Undoable.
tool:doc_set_info.desc: Set a document information entry such as Title, Author, Subject or Keywords. Undoable.

tool:doc_split.text0: Split into several files written to out_dir: every N pages, before given pages, at top-level bookmarks (bookmarks: true; files named after them), or by file size (max_mb). Files are <name>-partK.pdf.
tool:doc_split.desc: Split into several files written to out_dir: every N pages, before given pages, at top-level bookmarks (bookmarks: true; files named after them), or by file size (max_mb). Files are <name>-partK.pdf.

tool:doc_unprotect.text0: Remove password security (the document must have been opened with its permissions password, or have none). Applied by the next doc_save. Undoable.
tool:doc_unprotect.desc: Remove password security (the document must have been opened with its permissions password, or have none). Applied by the next doc_save. Undoable.

tool:doc_watermark.params: {behind?:boolean, color?:string, doc*:integer, file?:string, file_page?:integer, font_size?:number, opacity?:number, pages?:array, replace?:boolean, rotation?:number, scale?:number, text?:string}
tool:doc_watermark.text0: Add a watermark to pages: text, or a picture from `file` (an image, or page `file_page` of a PDF) at `scale` of the page (default 0.5); rotated (degrees counter-clockwise, default 45), semi-transparent (opacity 0–1, default 0.5), text fitted to the page unless font_size is given, on top unless behind: true. replace: true swaps out existing ones. tool:doc_watermark.desc: Add a watermark to pages: text, or a picture from `file` (an image, or page `file_page` of a PDF) at `scale` of the page (default 0.5); rotated (degrees counter-clockwise, default 45), semi-transparent (opacity 0–1, default 0.5), text fitted to the page unless font_size is given, on top unless behind: true. replace: true swaps out existing ones. Undoable.

tool:edit_undo.desc: Undo the last edit of a document.

tool:fill_sign_add.desc: Fill in a form that has no fields, as Acrobat's Fill & Sign does: type text (`text`, 10 pt), place a check, cross, dot or line, today's date, or a typed signature or initials (`text` drawn in a script font as filled outlines; at is its left edge, centred vertically), at `at` [x, y] in points from the top-left of the page (the text's top-left; a mark's centre). tool:form_actions.desc: Field Properties ▸ Actions: the field's action for each trigger (mouse_up, mouse_down, mouse_enter, mouse_exit, on_focus, on_blur).

tool:form_add_field.params: {caption?:string, doc*:integer, editable?:boolean, export?:string, group?:string, multi_select?:boolean, multiline?:boolean, name?:string, options?:array, page*:integer, rect*:array, type*:string}

tool:form_delete_field.desc: Delete a form field and all its widgets. Undoable.

tool:form_fields.desc: Every interactive form field: name, type (text, checkbox, radio, combo, list, button, signature), value, options, page and rect (top-left-origin points), read-only and required flags.

tool:form_reset.desc: Reset fields to their default values: all of them, or only those listed. Undoable.

note:bridge-has-its-own-documents.text0: Documents opened in the window with ui_open are invisible to doc_list, page_render and the other doc_* tools: the bridge has its own session. To render or edit a PDF through the MCP open it with doc_open path=<pdf> (a new document id), render with page_render {doc, page, dpi}, save with doc_save. ui_screenshot shows the window (it must be visible).
